name: Valkyrie Grace
desc: Summoning tokens spawns an extra 1/1 recruit.

name: Aether Flux
desc: Blinking or returning a unit draws 1 card.

name: Shadow Veil
desc: Whenever any unit dies, restore 2 HP to hero.

name: Plasma Surge
desc: Damage spells deal +2 flat bonus damage.

name: Titan Growth
desc: First creature played each turn gains +2/+2 stats.

name: Mirror Legion
desc: Whenever you create tokens, create twice that many instead, including attacking copies.

name: Living Mosaic
desc: Whenever you permanently morph a creature, it gets an additional perpetual +1/+1.
